preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
Number of days in each test case is between 1 and 100000.
Number of places in each test case is between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, all(1 <= A[i] <= K or A[i] == -1 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each day's plan is either a valid place number or -1.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, all(A[i] != A[i+1] for i in range(N-1) if A[i] != -1 and A[i+1] != -1)
preconditions.description: No two consecutive days have the same place if both are decided.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, output is 'YES' or 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output is either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating if the plan can be completed.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'YES', then the next line contains N space-separated integers representing the completed plan
postconditions.description: If the plan can be completed, the next line contains the completed plan.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'YES', then all(1 <= A[i] <= K for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: All days in the completed plan have valid place numbers.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'YES', then all(A[i] != A[i+1] for i in range(N-1))
postconditions.description: No two consecutive days in the completed plan have the same place.
